title: Read the release history
brief: Find the shop Application for the named environment. Read its latest deployed revision in History and the result of its last sync operation.

checks.question: Which Git revision was deployed most recently?
checks.hint: Open History and Rollback and read the latest revision.
checks.why: History links the deployment to a Git commit.

checks.question: What phase did the latest sync operation reach?
checks.hint: Open Sync Status and read the operation phase.
checks.why: The operation panel tells you whether the last apply completed.
